_: Country-code crosswalk for the living globe — FIPS 10-4 (GDELT) ↔ ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 / numeric / alpha-2 ↔ ccTLD, with the country name as Wikidata, Natural Earth, GDELT, EM-DAT and UCDP each spell it. Derived, never hand-edited: correct a code in src/data/globe/iso-fips.csv and rebuild.
derivation: src/data/globe/iso-fips.csv (ISO codes, FIPS 10-4, ccTLD) joined with src/data/globe/countries-110m.json by ISO numeric, with pipelines/balance/sources_by_country.csv by FIPS 10-4, with src/data/admissions/emdat.json by the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 suffix of its keys, and with src/data/admissions/ucdp-brd.json by country name after stripping a historical parenthetical.
regenerate: npx tsx scripts/build-globe-crosswalk.ts (--check fails on drift, writes nothing)
